# CrossChainRegistry
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/contracts/CrossChainRegistry.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ICrossChainRegistry](../interfaces/i-cross-chain-registry.md), ProtocolAccessManaged

**Title:**
CrossChainRegistry

Generic centralized registry for managing cross-chain relationships between different contract types

Inherits from ProtocolAccessManaged for access control and implements ICrossChainRegistry with support for
multiple relationship types


## State Variables
### CURRENT_CHAIN_ID
The chain ID of the current deployment


```solidity
uint16 private immutable CURRENT_CHAIN_ID
```


### crossChainRelations
Mapping from relationship key to relationship information
Key: keccak256(abi.encode(sourceContract, relationshipType))


```solidity
mapping(bytes32 => CrossChainRelation) private crossChainRelations
```

Mapping from target key to source contract address
Key: keccak256(abi.encode(sourceChainId, targetChainId, targetContract, relationshipType))


```solidity
mapping(bytes32 => address) private targetToSource
```


### registeredSourceContracts
EnumerableSet of all registered source contracts per relationship type


```solidity
mapping(bytes32 => EnumerableSet.AddressSet) private registeredSourceContracts
```

### getTargetForSource

Get the target contract and chain for a given source contract and relationship type

This function returns the first registered relationship. Use getTargetsForSource for multiple relationships.


```solidity
function getTargetForSource(
    address sourceContract,
    bytes32 relationshipType
)
    public
    view
    returns (address targetContract, uint16 targetChainId);
```
**Parameters**

|----|----|-----------|
|`sourceContract`|`address`|The address of the source contract|
|`relationshipType`|`bytes32`|The type of relationship|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targetContract`|`address`|The address of the target contract|
|`targetChainId`|`uint16`|The chain ID where the target contract is deployed|
